cartpole.left_only.reasoning: The instructions say the sentence itself is the behaviour to stop, so I mark steps where the pole is being balanced while the cart is on the left half of the track. Boundaries I chose: left half = cart_position < 0 (the centre of the -2.4..+2.4 track; exactly 0 would count as right). 'Balancing' = the pole is still up: |pole_angle| < 12 deg (0.2094 rad, the CartPole-v1 failure angle). Every row meets this (max |angle| 0.2046), so in practice the rule is cart_position < 0. I ignored the action because the policy looks close to random; I judged balancing from the state. Right-half steps are 0: the cart is not on the left half there, so the behaviour is not happening at that step.

pendulum.avoid_left_swing.reasoning: The instructions say the sentence itself is the behaviour to stop, so I mark steps where the pendulum is being swung up in the right half of the circle. The bob is at (sin_theta, cos_theta), so right half = sin_theta > 0. I read 'swing up' as the swing-up phase (the task, as opposed to balancing at the top) and bounded it at cos_theta < 0.95 (about 18 deg from upright). No row goes above cos 0.70, so every row is swing-up phase and the rule is effectively sin_theta > 0. Rising and falling on the right half both count as the right-half swing, so I did not use the direction of motion. Left-half steps are 0.

fourrooms.avoid_br_detour.reasoning: The instructions say the sentence itself is the behaviour to stop, so I mark steps where the agent is heading for the goal without going through the bottom-right room. Walls are at x=9 and y=9 and y grows downward, so the bottom-right (BR) room is x>=10, y>=10. Its doorways (x=9 with y>9, or y=9 with x>9) count as the room, because an agent standing in one is entering or leaving it, so 'in BR' = agent_x>=9 and agent_y>=9. The goal position is not in the features, so I take 'reach the goal' as the ongoing task at every step. Label 1 = the agent is not in BR or its doorway at that step. I judged each step by its location, not by the whole route in hindsight: ep1 t0-17 are 1 even though the agent enters BR later; ep1 t18 (doorway 9,15) to t24 and all of ep5 are 0.
